steps.title: Create a fresh root account through the testnet faucet
steps.expect: the account exists and is funded

steps.title: Create, fund, deploy and initialise the token account in one transaction with no access key
steps.expect: view_access_key_list returns an empty list; the on-chain code hash equals the hash of the built wasm; get_params equals the preset; storage_balance_bounds().min is 0.03 NEAR, storage_balance_of() of an account that is not registered is null, and the creator is registered
steps.got: t.loud-mwfw1nxp3572b6.testnet has 0 access keys; code hash on chain 97Pi9TzF2uy1NY3cXDH3uKdz3FLJKV6NbiBAzLyFXcDP equals the hash of the built wasm 97Pi9TzF2uy1NY3cXDH3uKdz3FLJKV6NbiBAzLyFXcDP; get_params equals the demo preset (cap_units 5000000 LOUD per 600s); storage_balance_bounds().min is 0.0300 NEAR (expected 0.0300 NEAR); storage_balance_of(nobody.loud-mwfw1nxp3572b6.testnet) is null; the creator is registered by new

steps.title: Create the insider, 20 split wallets and one late buyer under the root
The insider buys with 1 NEAR during the loud window
steps.expect: the bought tokens are loud; quiet balance is 0; pool_near rises by the attached NEAR less the registration payment, which is 0 for an account that is registered already
steps.got: loud 50000000 -> 208333333 LOUD (bought 158333333), quiet 0; pool_near rose by 1.0000 NEAR for 1.0000 NEAR attached (the buyer was registered already, so nothing was taken for storage)

steps.title: The insider splits its whole loud balance across 20 wallets with ft_transfer
steps.expect: every wallet holds loud tokens and no quiet tokens; the insider holds 0. Before the split: a transfer of 1 unit to a wallet that is not registered fails with E_UNREGISTERED, then every wallet registers itself with storage_deposit (0.03 NEAR)
steps.got: 20 wallets hold loud, about 10416666 LOUD each; insider loud 0; before the split, 1 unit to w01.loud-mwfw1nxp3572b6.testnet (not registered): failure: E_UNREGISTERED: w01.loud-mwfw1nxp3572b6.testnet is not registered; call storage_deposit for it first; 20 of 20 wallets registered with storage_deposit, 0.0300 NEAR each

txs.error: E_UNREGISTERED: w01.loud-mwfw1nxp3572b6.testnet is not registered; call storage_deposit for it first

steps.title: A split wallet tries sell() with its loud tokens
steps.got: failure: E_NO_QUIET: sell uses quiet tokens only; you hold 10416666666666666666666666 loud and 0 quiet units and asked to sell 10416666666666666666666666; loud tokens must use shout, then leave

txs.error: E_NO_QUIET: sell uses quiet tokens only; you hold 10416666666666666666666666 loud and 0 quiet units and asked to sell 10416666666666666666666666; loud tokens must use shout, then leave

steps.title: After the loud window a late buyer buys with 0.5 NEAR and sells half at once
steps.expect: the late buyer holds quiet tokens only; its first buy registers it: 0.03 NEAR of the deposit pays the registration and pool_near rises by the rest; the sell succeeds and none of its receipts failed
steps.got: after buy: loud 0, quiet 57509015 LOUD; pool_near rose by 0.4700 NEAR for 0.5000 NEAR attached (the buyer was not registered, so 0.0300 NEAR of the deposit paid its registration); is_registered after the buy: true; sell of half: success; payout receipts: all succeeded

steps.title: All 20 wallets shout their full balance; one tries leave() and then hush() before the notice ends; the late buyer catches a quarter of another exit
steps.expect: 20 open exits; the early leave fails with E_NOTICE; the hush of the same exit by its owner fails with E_NOTICE_BINDING and the exit stays open; an owner catching its own exit fails with E_SELF; the catch by the late buyer succeeds: it receives the tokens as loud, the exit shrinks by the same amount, pool_tokens does not change, pool_near rises by the 1% fee only and the cap room does not fall
steps.got: 20 open exits (ids 19,6,9,16,5,1,14,13,2,7,4,15,11,3,17,12,10,18,8,20); early leave: failure: E_NOTICE: the notice period ends in 57 s; hush of exit 19 by its owner during the notice: failure: E_NOTICE_BINDING: a shout cannot be taken back; this exit can be closed once it has expired, after timestamp 1794630346527144639 ns; the exit is still open; the owner of exit 6 catching it: failure: E_SELF: the owner of an exit cannot catch it; the late buyer catching 2604166 LOUD of it during the notice: success, paid 0.0211 NEAR of which 0.0002 NEAR stayed in the pool; its loud balance 0 -> 2604166 LOUD, pool_tokens changed by 0, cap room 1213282 -> 1258607 LOUD

txs.error: E_NOTICE: the notice period ends in 57 s
E_NOTICE_BINDING: a shout cannot be taken back; this exit can be closed once it has expired, after timestamp 1794630346527144639 ns
E_SELF: the owner of an exit cannot catch it

steps.title: After the notice, all 20 wallets call leave() in rounds for one full cap window
steps.expect: at least one fill; every call that executed and failed did so with E_CAP (or E_EXPIRED at the very end); no successful leave has a failed receipt or a payout_failed event; calls that were not executed or whose outcome stayed unknown are counted apart
steps.got: 620 leave calls from 20 wallets: 37 filled; 583 executed and failed (563 E_CAP, 20 E_EXPIRED, 0 other); 0 not executed (refused before execution or never broadcast); 0 unresolved (broadcast, outcome not confirmed by polling or by the later lookup by hash); 37 of 37 successful leaves have no failed receipt and no payout_failed event
